line1.speaker: Scratched into the rock
line1.text: The slab answers to the plate, and the plate answers only to [shake]weight[/shake].

line2.speaker: Scratched into the rock
line2.text: Ink is not weight. Yours runs out. Find something that stays.

line3.speaker: Scratched into the rock
line3.text: There is a stone on the shelf above. Give it a road and let it fall.
